description: Implement the Effects system (MobEffects), Block implementations (OilSurfaceBlock, trap blocks, mechanism blocks, puzzle blocks), custom Items with abilities, and Curios API integration for accessories.
steps: Create OiledEffect.java in effect/ extending MobEffect: fire damage 2x multiplier, friction reduction -30% per level, visual overlay sync, propagation on player contact, tick logic.
Create OilProtectionEffect.java in effect/ extending MobEffect: prevents OiledEffect application for duration, visual golden particles.
Create MadnessEffect.java in effect/: shader distortion trigger, false sound events, scale with level (0-100).
Create ResonanceChargeEffect.java in effect/: sound sensitivity increase, crystal interaction boost.
Create HemorrhageEffect.java in effect/: DOT (damage over time), stacking.
Create FrostSlowEffect.java in effect/: movement slow, vision reduction.
Create SolarBurnEffect.java in effect/: continuous burn in light, cure in shadow.
Create SanityDrainEffect.java in effect/: gradual madness buildup, cure with candle/food.
Create OilSurfaceBlock.java in block/: no collision (carpet-like), ignitedByLava, onSteppedOn applies OiledEffect, bone meal interaction destroys block, water interaction creates steam explosion.
Create SpikePlateBlock.java in block/trap/: extends Block with blockstate for extended/retracted, damages on step, visual animation state property.
Create ResonanceCrystalBlock.java in block/puzzle/ with CHARGE_LEVEL IntegerProperty (0-5), light level based on charge, BlockEntity reference.
Create HiddenButtonBlock.java in block/puzzle/: invisible until revealed by spyglass/sculk, standard button behavior once visible.
Create BrazierBlock.java in block/mechanism/: lit/unlit state, ignitable by flint and steel, provides light when lit.
Create MirrorPanelBlock.java in block/puzzle/: directional, rotatable by fishing rod, redirects light beams.
Create PushableBlock.java in block/mechanism/: can be pushed by players and pistons, used in weight puzzles.
Create GoldenMechanismBlock.java in block/mechanism/: activated by gold items, triggers mechanism chain.
Create IcePlateBlock.java in block/: slippery surface, honey bottle interaction removes slip.
Create MembraneBlock.java in block/: semi-permeable, certain entities can pass through.
Create CDEWeaponItem.java base class in item/: custom weapons with ability on right-click.
Create concrete weapons: CounterweightHammer.java (slam AoE), SurgeonBlade.java (precision strikes, hemorrhage), MadnessRapier.java (madness on hit), BlizzardBow.java (frost arrows).
Create FrostCrownItem.java in item/curio/ following section 7.11 exactly: ICurioItem, frost immunity aura, cold damage to nearby enemies every 20 ticks.
Create OracleRelicItem.java in item/curio/: ICurioItem, reveals hidden buttons and trap positions.
Create WindcutterCloakItem.java in item/curio/: ICurioItem, increased movement speed and fall damage reduction.
Create SanityCandle.java in item/: consumable, removes SanityDrain and Madness effects.
Create EscapeCrystal.java in item/: teleports player to dungeon entrance, single use.
acceptance_criteria: All 8+ MobEffect implementations have proper tick logic and Holder references
OilSurfaceBlock implements onSteppedOn for OiledEffect, handles bone meal and water interactions
ResonanceCrystalBlock has CHARGE_LEVEL property affecting light level
All trap/mechanism/puzzle blocks have appropriate BlockState properties
CDEWeaponItem base provides right-click ability framework
At least 4 concrete weapons with unique abilities
FrostCrownItem exactly matches section 7.11 ICurioItem pattern
At least 3 Curios items with curioTick, onEquip, onUnequip implementations
verification: OiledEffect.applyEffectTick increases fire damage and reduces friction
OilSurfaceBlock.onSteppedOn checks for OilProtection before applying OiledEffect
FrostCrownItem.curioTick applies frost slow to enemies in radius every 20 ticks
All block/item classes reference correct registry entries from CDEBlocks/CDEItems
findings: All 33 files (32 new + 1 modified CDEEffects.java) successfully created. 9 MobEffect implementations, 12 block implementations, 5 item classes (CDEWeaponItem base + 4 weapons), 3 curio items, 2 utility items. Internal cross-references verified - all imports between mod files resolve correctly. Package declarations match filesystem paths. Braces balanced. CDEBlocks/CDEItems NOT modified per orchestrator constraint - the registry still creates generic Block/Item instances that will need updating to reference the new implementation classes in a separate step. NeoForge 1.21.1 API patterns used: applyEffectTick(ServerLevel, LivingEntity, int), ItemStack.hurtAndBreak(int, LivingEntity, EquipmentSlot), DeferredHolder as Holder<MobEffect> in MobEffectInstance constructors. Cannot verify full compilation due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode.
